title: Sponsorship Solicitation for MWR Elements of DAF Sports Programs
description: *This is a solicitation for commercial sponsorship by a Nonappropriated Fund Instrumentality of the United States Government. It does not obligate appropriated funds or nonappropriated funds of the Government.* Introduction to MWR The U.S. Air Force Morale, Welfare, and Recreation (MWR) program is a comprehensive support initiative designed to enhance the quality of life for Air Force personnel and their families. The program offers a wide range of services, facilities, and activities aimed at promoting well-being, fitness, and morale among military members. Key elements of the MWR program include recreational activities such as sports leagues, fitness centers, outdoor recreation programs, hobby shops, and arts & crafts centers; family and community support through child development centers, youth programs, and family support services; entertainment and leisure options including movie theaters, libraries, and special events; and travel and hospitality services like lodging, dining facilities, and recreational lodging. Non-federal entities can sponsor various elements of the MWR program to gain access to the military market. Sponsorship provides businesses with a unique opportunity to engage with a dedicated and diverse audience while supporting the well-being of Air Force personnel and their families. Benefits of sponsorship include brand exposure through event signage, marketing materials, and digital media, direct engagement with participants through on-site presence and product demonstrations, community involvement with a positive association to the military, and access to a large and engaged military audience. Sponsorship opportunities include event sponsorship for sports tournaments, holiday celebrations, and family fun days; facility enhancements for fitness centers and recreational facilities; program support for educational workshops and health programs; and marketing and advertising in MWR publications and social media channels. By sponsoring the U.S. Air Force MWR program, non-federal entities can enhance their brand presence, support the military community, and gain valuable access to the military market. DAF Sports Sponsorship The Department of the Air Force (DAF) offers a variety of sports sponsorship opportunities designed to enhance the morale, welfare, and recreation of Air Force personnel and their families. These opportunities allow businesses to support athletic and recreational programs while gaining visibility and access to a dedicated and diverse military audience. Sponsoring DAF sports programs provides unique benefits for both sponsors and participants, fostering community engagement and promoting physical fitness. Sponsorship opportunities include annual sports events such as the Air Force Marathon, basketball tournaments, and soccer leagues, as well as one-off competitions and championships. Fitness and wellness programs also offer sponsorship potential, with opportunities to support fitness centers, health challenges, and wellness workshops. Sponsors benefit from high brand exposure through event branding, marketing materials, digital media, and on-site presence. Opportunities for logo placement, sponsor mentions, and inclusion in promotional campaigns are available, along with direct interaction with participants and attendees, including product demonstrations and sampling. Sponsorship provides access to a large and engaged military audience, including active duty members, families, and veterans, offering insight into the preferences and behaviors of military personnel. Involvement in DAF sports programs also enhances corporate social responsibility (CSR) by demonstrating support for the well-being of Air Force personnel and their families and fostering a positive association with the military community. To become a sponsor, businesses should review the DAF sports calendar found on DAFsports.com to identify events or programs that align with their brand and sponsorship goals. Detailed information on available opportunities can be obtained by contacting the DAF sponsorship office. Sponsors should develop a proposal outlining their goals, desired level of involvement, and proposed contributions, highlighting the benefits to both the DAF sports program and their organization. After submitting the proposal to the sponsorship office, businesses will work with DAF representatives to finalize the details and agree on terms. Implementation involves coordinating with DAF staff to ensure active participation and engagement throughout the sponsorship period. Finally, sponsors should assess the impact of their sponsorship through feedback and performance metrics and consider renewing or expanding their sponsorship based on the results and ongoing opportunities. For more information on sponsorship opportunities or to start the sponsorship process, businesses can contact the Sponsorship Office via email. By sponsoring DAF sports programs, businesses can enhance their brand presence, demonstrate support for the military community, and gain valuable access to the military market.

Des Weiteren muss es sich bei den Bietern um einen Zertifizierten Entsorgungsfachbetrieb handeln. description: Das BASE ist Genehmigungs- und Aufsichtsbehörde des Bundes für nukleare Sicherheit und kerntechnische Entsorgung und Träger der Öffentlichkeitsbeteiligung im Standortauswahlverfahren für ein Endlager für hochradioaktive Abfälle. Der Auftragnehmer (AN) unterstützt das Bundesamt für die Sicherheit der nuklearen Entsorgung (BASE) bei der Erfüllung seines gesetzlichen Auftrags in den unterschiedlichen Zuständigkeitsbereichen, indem er öffentliche Diskussionen, Wahrnehmungen, Meinungsbilder und Entwicklungen beobachtet und das BASE dabei unterstützt, einen zielgerichteten Dialog mit Akteuren aus der Öffentlichkeit zu führen. Ein besonderer Fokus liegt auf der Endlagersuche und damit zusammenhängenden Themenfeldern der nuklearen Entsorgung. Es ist zentrale Aufgabe des BASE, Information und Beteiligung verschiedener Stakeholder bzw. Anspruchsgruppen (u. a. Bürger:innen, kommunale Gebietskörperschaften, gesellschaftliche Organisationen, Wissenschaftler:innen) zu ermöglichen. Ein umfassendes und aktuelles Stimmungsbild der öffentlichen (veröffentlichten) (d.h. „offensichtlich öffentlich gemachten“ im Sinne von Art. 9 Abs. 2 lit. e DSGVO) Wahrnehmungen und Meinungen zur nuklearen Entsorgung mit besonderem Fokus auf die Endlagersuche und die Zwischenlagerung bildet dafür eine wichtige Grundlage. - Weitere Einzelheiten zum Vertragsgegenstand und zur konkreten Leistungserbringung ergeben sich aus der Vergabeunterlage 04 „Leistungsbeschreibung“.

title: Neubau Verkehrsanlagen (Gleisbau und Entwässerungsanlagen) von km 0,1+00 bis km 3,8+37 (VE4303) für das Infrastrukturprojekt Regionaltangente West (RTW)
description: Die Regionaltangente West (RTW) ist eine neue tangentiale Schienenverbindung im Rhein-Main-Gebiet zur Verbesserung des öffentlichen Schienenpersonennahverkehrs im Ballungsraum Frankfurt am Main. Sie dient in erster Linie der besseren Verbindung der westlichen Stadtteile der Stadt Frankfurt am Main sowie der umliegenden Kreise, Städte und Gemeinden miteinander und untereinander und der besseren Anbindung an den Frankfurter Flughafen. Das Projekt ist in die Planfeststellungsabschnitte PFA Nord, PFA Mitte sowie die PFA Süd I und Süd II aufgeteilt. Die hier gegenständliche Ausschreibung liegt im Planfeststellungsabschnitt Süd 1. Der Planfeststellungsbeschluss Süd 1 liegt den Verdingungsunterlagen bei und ist bei der Bauausführung zu beachten. Gegenstand der vorliegenden Ausschreibung sind folgende Leistungen: Herstellung eines ein- und zweigleisigen Streckenoberbau nach EBO im Bereich Mörfelder Landstraße bis Bf Neu-Isenburg (km 0,1+00 bis km 3,8+37) im Planfeststellungsabschnitt Süd 1, sowie die erforderlichen infrastrukturellen Anbindungen an die Bestandsinfrastruktur der Strecken 3650, 35651 und 3688 der DB InfraGO AG. Die gegenständlichen Maßnahmen beinhalten sowohl der ein- und zweigleisigen Streckenabschnitte der Anbindungen an die Bestandsinfrastruktur der DB InfraGO AG, als auch alle hierfür durch den AN zu erbringenden bauvorbereitenden Zusammenhangsarbeiten (z.B. technische Bearbeitung, Leitungsumlegungs-/sicherungsmaßnahmen, Gründungsarbeiten, Einbau Weichen und Weichenheizungsanlagen, Kabeltiefbauarbeiten und -verlegung, Kampfmittelsondierungsleistungen, Sicherungsleistungen etc.). Eine detaillierte Beschreibung der zu erbringenden Leistungen kann den Vergabeunterlagen entnommen werden.

title: Rammeavtale elektromateriell
description: Oppdragsgiver forvalter flere kirker, gravplasser og øvrige eiendommer, noe som medfører at oppdragsgiver har et løpende behov for elektromateriell til drift og vedlikehold. Oppdragsgiver skal inngå en rammeavtale med én leverandør, og formålet med anskaffelsen er å sikre at Bergen kirkelige fellesråd får dekket sitt samlede behov for elektromateriell på en effektiv og hensiktsmessig måte. Ved større prosjekter vil oppdragsgiver forespørre leverandør om prosjektpriser, hvor også tilkjøring og levering vil være en viktig del av oppdraget.Oppdragsgiver har i dag en tilsvarende rammeavtale med Onninen som utløper januar 2027. Forventet oppstart på denne rammeavtalen er derfor januar 2027. Avtalen inngås for en periode på to (2) år fra signeringsdato. Oppdragsgiver har opsjon til å forlenge avtalen med ett (1) år av gangen, i inntil to (2) ganger. Maksimal samlet avtaleperiode er fire (4) år. Opsjoner utløses ved skriftlig beskjed av oppdragsgiver minimum tre (3) måneder før utløp. Avtalen opphører automatisk ved utløp av avtaleperioden. Dersom alle opsjoner benyttes er anskaffelsens forventede totalverdi kr. 10 000 000, med et årlig forventede uttak på kr. 2 5000 000. Maksimal kontraktsverdi er kr. 15 000 000. Summen er beregnet på historiske data.

title: MP-080093 – Planification de l’entretien EP F5: inspections principales BAU+BSA des tunnels et galeries des routes nationales N02, N13 et NEB N13, Tessin et Mesolcina, 2027-2031
description:
L’Office fédéral des routes (OFROU), filiale de Bellinzone, met au concours, selon une procédure ouverte, un mandat confié à des bureaux d’ingénieurs externes pour la réalisation des inspections principales de génie civil (BAU) et des inspections principales des équipements électromécaniques (BSA) des tunnels et galeries des routes nationales.


Les soumissionnaires sont chargés de réaliser les activités d’inspection, d’évaluation et de documentation de l’état des tunnels et galeries ainsi que de leurs équipements.


Les prestations comprennent la préparation des inspections, le relevé et l’analyse des dommages, la mise à jour des inventaires et des banques de données KUBA et FA-BSA, ainsi que la définition des besoins d’intervention et des mesures de conservation. Sont également compris la rédaction de la documentation technique, la présentation périodique des résultats au maître d'ouvrage et l’établissement des rapports d’inspection finaux.


Le présent mandat porte sur l’inspection, l’évaluation de l’état et la surveillance des tunnels et galeries situés sur la route nationale N02, entre la douane de Chiasso-Brogeda et le portail sud du tunnel du Saint-Gothard, sur la route nationale N13, entre Bellinzone-Nord et le portail nord du tunnel du San Bernardino, ainsi que sur le tronçon NEB de la N13, entre Bellinzone-Sud et Ascona, pour la période allant du printemps 2027 à la fin de l’année 2031.


Le mandat est subdivisé en deux lots :


·        Lot 1 - Tunnels et galeries du Tessin

·        Lot 2 Tunnels et galeries de la Mesolcina

 

Pour une description détaillée des prestations et le nombre total d’heures prévues, se référer à la documentation d’appel d’offres, au contrat et au tableau des prestations.

title: Spital Männedorf TE3 - Teiletappe 3
description:
Spital Männedorf is conducting a two-stage design-build competition for Teiletappe 3 using a selective procedure with dialogue.

The contract comprises the planning and implementation of a new building, as well as the partial refurbishment and further development of the existing hospital infrastructure under a design-build mandate.

The scope of work includes, in particular:

  • Expansion of Haus 3 with approximately 40 patient rooms and around 60 beds
  • Reorganisation of the main entrance and primary circulation/access routes
  • Improvement of operational processes and internal logistics
  • Reorganisation of the main access road, including the redesign of the outdoor spaces
  • Ensuring construction works can be carried out while maintaining ongoing hospital operations

The outcome of the procedure will be a clearly defined project, together with a binding cost proposal for planning and construction, to be executed under a design-build or turnkey contractor agreement.

title: Livraison de bois (lots 1 et 2)
description:
Le présent appel d’offres porte sur la livraison de différents produits en bois et est subdivisé en deux lots.


Le lot 1 comprend des panneaux en bois massif, en aggloméré, en contreplaqué et en MDF, ainsi que des tasseaux et des baguettes.

Le lot 2 comprend des lames de revêtement, des lattes pour bancs et des bois équarris.


Pour chaque lot, les deux soumissionnaires les mieux classés se verront attribuer un marché (deux partenaires contractuels par lot dans le cadre d’un contrat-cadre).

Les livraisons seront effectuées principalement au centre d’exploitation en régie situé à Zurich-Altstetten, ainsi que, selon les besoins, sur d’autres sites de la ville de Zurich et des environs immédiats. Le périmètre des prestations comprend les livraisons groupées, individuelles et express, ainsi que l’échange de données via ComNorm. Le reporting requis et le respect des exigences définies en matière de qualité, d’environnement et de durabilité font également partie du marché.

Tous les frais de transport, d’administration et les frais accessoires doivent être inclus dans les prix proposés.

title: Finland – Construction work – Ruovedentie 36 Säästökulman kiinteistön purku-urakka
description: Ruoveden kunta pyytää tarjousta omistamansa asuin- ja liikekiinteistö Säästökulman purku-urakasta tarjouspyyntöasiakirjojen mukaisesti. Purkukohde sijaitsee osoitteessa Ruovedentie 36, 34600 Ruovesi. Urakka sisältää rakennuksen purkamisen kokonaisuudessaan, purkujätteen asianmukaisen lajittelun, käsittelyn ja poiskuljetuksen sekä purkamisen jälkeiset maanrakennus-, täyttö- ja maisemointityöt. Kohteen sisätiloissa suoritetaan parhaillaan erillinen asbestipurku ja siihen liittyvä siivous laittoman haitta-ainepurun seurauksena. Suoritettavien töiden yhteydessä sisätiloista poistetaan tiedossa olevat asbesti- ja haitta-ainepitoiset materiaalit. Rakennuksen perustuksissa, julkisivuissa sekä muissa rakenteissa saattaa kuitenkin edelleen esiintyä haitta-aineita sisältäviä materiaaleja. Näiden materiaalien purkaminen, käsittely, pakkaaminen, kuljetus ja asianmukainen toimittaminen hyväksyttyyn vastaanottopaikkaan sisältyvät purku-urakkaan urakka-asiakirjoissa esitetyssä laajuudessa sekä voimassa olevien viranomaismääräysten mukaisesti. Tilaajalla on samanaikaisesti tarjouslaskennassa sisällöltään lähes vastaava purku-urakka. Kyseinen kohde sijaitsee noin 50 metrin etäisyydellä tästä purkukohteesta, ja kohteiden väliin jää yksi kiinteistö. Purkutyöt voidaan toteuttaa joko samanaikaisesti tai peräkkäin urakoitsijan tuotantosuunnittelun mukaisesti. Tarjoajaa pyydetään huomioimaan kyseinen mahdollinen synergiaetu tarjouslaskennassaan. Kohteet kilpailutetaan ja tilataan kuitenkin erillisinä toisistaan riippumattomina urakoina. Kumpaankin kohteeseen valitaan erikseen urakoitsija tarjouspyyntöasiakirjojen mukaisesti. Valintaperusteena on hinnaltaan halvin hyväksyt-tävä tarjous. Tarjouspyyntödokumentti, soveltuvuusvaatimukset, hankinnan kohde ja tarkemmat hankinnan tiedot tutustuttavissa latauslinkin takaa. Kohteeseen tutustuminen 7.12.2026 klo 9.00–10.00. Ilmoittautuminen esko.moisio@caverion.com, p. 050 347 8206 Urakkaan liittyvät kysymykset on toimitettava esko.moisio@caverion.com 9.12 mennessä. Kysymyksiin vastataan 11.12. Vastaukset julkaistaan kunnan verkkosivuilla Tiedotteet-osiossa www.ruovesi.fi. Tarjoukset jätetään sähköpostilla esko.moisio@caverion.com 23.12 kello 14:00 mennessä.

title: Pre-Solicitation Notice for Indefinite Delivery Contract (IDC) for Regional Dredge Multiple Award Task Order (MATOC) - USACE Huntington District - W91237-27-R-A003
description: 1. CONTRACT INFORMATION: The contract consists of a base period of one-year with four option periods, one-year each for maintenance dredging and/or clearing and snagging services for Ohio River Government Lock facilities and Ohio River open channel areas (within commercial navigation limits) located in the geographical boundaries of the following U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Great Lakes and Ohio River Division Districts: Nashville (LRN), Louisville (LRL), Huntington (LRH), and Pittsburgh (LRP). There will be no site visit for this requirement. The award of a target of (3) Firm Fixed price Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity Multiple Award Task Order Contracts (IDIQ-MATOC) is anticipated. The contracts will be awarded to up to three (3) qualifying Offerors. The total capacity for the sum of all task orders issued under these contracts is a shared Not to Exceed (NTE) amount of $45,000,000.00. This announcement is open to all businesses regardless of size. The NAICS code for this procurement is 237990, which has a size standard of $37 million in average annual receipts. If a large business is awarded this contract, it must comply with RFO Clause 52.219-9 Alt II Small Business Subcontracting Plan, Alternate II. Solicitation documents will be available on or about November 10, 2026, and can be downloaded at https://www.sam.gov. 2. PROJECT INFORMATION: The primary objective of this contract is to provide maintenance dredging and/or clearing and snagging services for Ohio River Government lock facilities and Ohio River open channel areas (within commercial navigation limits) located anywhere within the geographical boundaries of the following Great Lakes and Ohio River Division Districts: Nashville (LRN), Louisville (LRL), Huntington (LRH), and Pittsburgh (LRP). This includes work on any navigable tributary of the Ohio River system.3. SELECTION CRITERIA: All proposals will be evaluated on the basis of the factors stated below to award a contract to each and all qualifying offerors. There will be no trade-offs performed. Awards of MATOCs will be made to those offerors that are determined to be a responsible source, submitting a technically acceptable proposal that conforms to the requirements of the solicitation, and the Contracting Officer has no reason to believe would be likely to offer other than fair and reasonable pricing. FACTOR 1: Technical Capability - This factor evaluates the offerors proposed capability to perform specific dredging and related tasks that may be required under the basic contract and all option periods. FACTOR 2: Equipment - Offeror shall provide documentation for all marine floating plant/equipment being proposed for use under this solicitation/contract and any subsequent task orders. FACTOR 3: Past Performance - Provide descriptions of at least one (1) and no more than three (3) projects completed or substantially complete (90% or more) within seven (7) years from issuance of the solicitation that are similar in scope, magnitude, and complexity to the work under this MATOC. Self-performance of at least 50% of the total cost of the project is required. FACTOR 4: Small Business Participation Plan - This factor evaluates the offerors proposed level of participation of Small Business (as prime and/or subcontractor) relative to the following goals: Small Business (SB) - minimum mandatory (23%), Small Disadvantaged Business (SDB) (13%), Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB) (5%), Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB) (5%), Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) (5%), and HUBZone Small Business (3%).4. SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS: Proposers shall submit all documents electronically through PIEE Solicitation Module at www.piee.eb.mil. No paper copies, CD, DVD, thumb drives, email, or facsimile will be accepted. To be eligible for award, a firm must be registered in System for Award Management (SAM). Register via the SAM internet site at www. SAM.gov. Questions may be submitted to Amy L. Davis; amy.l.davis@usace.army.mil. Please note, as of April 2018, GSAs System for Award Management (SAM) system requires new registrations and renewals of existing registrations to submit an original signed notarized letter identifying the authorized Entity Administrator. The notarized letter is not to be submitted to the Huntington Contracting Office as it is not our requirement. Vendors are encouraged to check their entitys status in www.SAM.gov and plan accordingly. If the prospective contractor is not registered in the SAM database, the Contracting Officer will follow the procedures in FAR 4.1103. Contact the supporting Federal Service Desk at www.fsd.gov, or by telephone at 866-606-8220 (toll free) or 334-206-7828 (internationally) Monday through Friday from 8am to 8pm EDT, for free assistance. The SAM registration process may take several weeks to process once submitted. Please carefully consider this information when deciding to submit your proposal.

title: Bravo Dive Boat 65DS1101
description: AMENDMENT 0003 POSTED 11/26. AMENDMENT 0002 POSTED 11/21. AMENDMENT 0001 POSTED 11/19. The Regional Maintenance Center at Puget Sound Naval Shipyard & Intermediate Maintenance Facility (PSNS & IMF) intends to award a stand-alone Firm-Fixed-Price contract to accomplish the maintenance, repair, and preservation in support of one (1) 65 FT BRAVO DIVE BOAT 65DS1101. Work will be accomplished at the Contractor's facility. Geographical Area of consideration: To facilitate proper government oversight, the facility shall be located in the Puget Sound, WA region. For this procurement, the Puget Sound, WA region is defined as the West Coast of the continental US, starting from Olympia, WA and extending northward to Bellingham, WA. 65DS1101 Length: 69 FT 10 IN Width: 22 FT 0 IN Draft: 3 FT 6 IN Full Displacement: 55 L TONS Age: 13 YEARS Light Load: 8,000 lbs Hull Type: Aluminum Scope Overview: Coordinate with the Contracting Officer, via the Contracting Officer�s Representative (COR) to deliver the vessel to the Contractor�s facility from Puget Sound Naval Shipyard (PSNS) Bremerton, WA. Remove all fendering and sweep blast clean. Accomplish survey of hull to identify and repair corrosion, preserve the exterior above and below the waterline, including the crane. Apply nonskid to horizontal surfaces on the exterior and interior of the boat. Replace motor mounts. Remove, inspect and install shafting, rudders and propellers. HVAC repair. Maintain and repair watertight hatches and doors. Repair, modify and preserve push knee. Replace and modify corroded deck and bulkhead structure in the main cabin. Install remote fuel shut offs. Identify and repair corrosion beneath the transformers in the aft lazzarette, install a weather shield above the starboard transformer in the aft lazzarette. Replace hydraulic, and fuel hoses. Identify and repair corroded structure beneath the shower room drain. Remove windows, repair window heaters, and reinstall windows. Replace fire suppression system piping and recertify system. Repair damage to the port bow. Accomplish modification and repair of swim platform stairs. Restore preservation system on the console in the pilot house. Replace existing generators with supplied Kohler generators, Modify, repair and install fendering system. Modify and repair the monkey heater system. Remove, inspect, preserve and install rudders. Replace thru hull valves and flexible hoses. Replace false bulkheads in the shower room and head. Open, clean and inspect all tanks. Perform sea trials after completion of repairs and full cure time of preservation. Arrange and coordinate the delivery of the vessel back to the Government with the Contracting Officer via the COR. The Period of Performance is expected to be 25 March 2026 to 29 May 2026. This is a 100% Small Business set-aside under the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) 336611, size standard 1,300 employees. All offerors must be registered with the System for Award Management (SAM) to receive award of Government contracts. Offerors are advised also that SAM representations and certifications can be completed electronically via the System for Award Management website at https://www.sam.gov. NOTE 1: Please pay particular attention to the inclusion of DFARS 252.232-7998 Obligations in Advance of Fiscal Year 2026 Funding (DEVIATION 2026-O0001). NOTE 2: Please review Request for Quote instructions regarding contract financing.

title: Un système d’imagerie quantitative 3D de cellules vivantes sans marquage
description:
L’EPFL prévoit d’acquérir un système d’imagerie quantitative 3D de cellules vivantes sans marquage (holotomographie, ou technologie équivalente de tomographie optique par diffraction/interférométrie), équipé d’un module intégré de fluorescence multicanal, destiné à son laboratoire Mechanics of Soft and Biological Matter Laboratory (MESOBIO) de la School of Engineering (STI). 

L’équipement sera dédié à des recherches de pointe nécessitant l’observation quantitative, non invasive et tridimensionnelle de cellules vivantes au cours du temps, corrélée au marquage fluorescent de structures cellulaires spécifiques. 

Compte tenu des besoins de l’EPFL et des objectifs scientifiques spécifiques de son laboratoire MESOBIO, l’accent sera mis sur les axes de recherche suivants : 

Imagerie quantitative et corrélative de cellules vivantes, combinant la tomographie 3D sans marquage basée sur l’indice de réfraction et la microscopie à fluorescence ciblée, notamment pour : 

• le suivi quantitatif à long terme de la morphologie des cellules vivantes, de leur masse sèche et de la dynamique de leur volume, sans fixation ni marquage,

• l’imagerie multimodale corrélative combinant la tomographie 3D sans marquage et le marquage fluorescent d’organites spécifiques ou de cibles moléculaires,

• l’étude de la dynamique hors équilibre et des transitions de phase dans la matière vivante au moyen de mesures quantitatives de la structure et de la dynamique aux échelles cellulaire et subcellulaire.

buyer: Office fédéral des routes OFROU - Division Infrastructure routière Est - F3 Zofingue
title: N02, Secondo tubo San Gottardo (2TG Röhre Nord und Galleria di Airolo) und N02 Risanamento primo tubo San Gottardo (1TG Röhre Süd) Lot 1001 – Notstromversorgung
description:
Afin de permettre la rénovation du tunnel routier du Gothard existant, long d'environ 17 km, le Conseil fédéral, le Parlement et la population ont décidé de construire un deuxième tube. L'équipement EES du deuxième tube, appelé tube nord, sera réalisé entre 2027 et 2030, en partie parallèlement à l'achèvement des travaux de construction du génie civil. Parallèlement au tube nord, la Galleria di Airolo (GdA), d'une longueur d'environ 1 km, sera également réalisée et fera partie intégrante du système du Gothard.

Immédiatement après l'ouverture du tube nord en circulation bidirectionnelle, la rénovation du tube existant, appelé tube sud, sera effectuée. La rénovation génie civil est prévue entre 2030 et 2033. L'équipement EES existant du tube sud sera entièrement démantelé en raison de son âge. La réalisation du nouvel équipement EES se fera en partie parallèlement à l'exploitation du trafic et devrait durer jusqu'en 2036. À terme, le GTG fonctionnera en sens unidirectionnel (une voie plus une bande d'arrêt d'urgence par tube) à une vitesse de 80 km/h. Cependant, la fermeture d'un tube sera régulièrement nécessaire pour des raisons d'entretien ou en cas d'incident.

 

Le présent lot comprend:

Études, contrôles, fourniture et montage des installations UPS (alimentations sans interruption) et des installations de batteries pour le tube Nord, le tube Sud et la Galerie di Airolo.

buyer: Office fédéral des constructions et de la logistique OFCL
title: (b26045-11) Rümlang, Heuelstrasse 100, CFA Rümlang / CFC 244
description:
Un nouveau centre fédéral pour requérants d’asile sans tâches procédurales sera construit à Rümlang, dans la région d’asile de Zurich, sur une partie de parcelle utilisée jusqu’ici par l’armée. Le centre devrait être opérationnel en 2028. Le site se trouve dans une zone boisée à 2 kilomètres du centre de Rümlang.

Le centre fédéral pour requérants d’asile sans tâches procédurales offrira 150 lits et 4 postes de travail. Le programme des locaux comprend des bureaux pour les processus d’entrée et d’enregistrement ainsi que les tâches administratives, des lieux de séjour, des locaux destinés à la restauration et des chambres ainsi que deux salles de classe pour les enfants en âge d’être scolarisés. Le terrain offre une surface suffisante pour aménager des extérieurs adaptés.

Les nouveaux bâtiments seront construits en dur avec une façade légère présentant un revêtement en bois. Outre la construction d’un nouveau bâtiment destiné à accueillir les chambres et les locaux réservés au contrôle des accès, il est prévu de transformer un bâtiment existant pour y installer une cantine. Tous les autres bâtiments et toutes les autres installations seront démolis, à l’exception du transformateur et de la station de pompage.

description: De applicaties Grond365 en Lood365 ondersteunen de werkprocessen binnen de afdeling Bodem van de gemeente Amsterdam. Grond365 vormt het zwaartepunt: deze applicatie zorgt voor de vastlegging van voorraadbeheer, logistieke processen en wettelijk verplichte gegevens rondom grondverzet. Amsterdam verplaatst en hergebruikt jaarlijks grote hoeveelheden grond via depots met weegbruggen; de applicatie ondersteunt dit proces van aanvraag tot facturering. Lood365 is een aparte applicatie op hetzelfde platform, gericht op het beheer en de uitwisseling van gegevens. Deze applicatie zorgt voor de vastlegging van loodonderzoeken, afspraken met bewoners en rapportage. Qua omvang en gebruik is Lood365 van minder betekenis dan Grond365; het meeste ontwikkelwerk concentreert zich op Grond365. De afdeling zoekt een samenwerkingspartner die proactief meedenkt over de automatisering van de Amsterdamse milieu hygiënische en logistieke grond processen en hoe de functionaliteiten van het (power)platform hier een bijdrage aan kunnen leveren.

The maintenance shop is anticipated to be a pre-engineered metal building and will include maintenance bays, management office, open cubicle work areas, electrical room, restroom, locker room, kitchen, tool room, and storage mezzanine. Also located at the maintenance shop will be new pre-engineered metal buildings for the equipment and hazardous material sheds. The project is also anticipated to include the demolition and removal of two (2) existing buildings and three (3) shed structures, as well as new building construction, grading, utilities, oxidation pond relining, asphaltic concrete paving, sidewalks, curbs, fencing, and landscaping.The Government estimates that construction of the anticipated requirement can be completed within seven hundred and twenty (720) calendar days from receipt of Notice to Proceed (NTP).The anticipated requirement will be awarded as a firm-fixed-price contract by approximately March 2026.In accordance with Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) 236.204-5(i), the Government currently estimates the magnitude of construction for this project to be between $10,000,000.00 and $25,000,000.00.The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for the potential requirement is anticipated to be 236220, Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. The small business size standard for this NAICS, as established by the U.S. Small Business Administration, is $45 million annual revenue. The Product Service Code for the potential requirement is anticipated to be Y1JZ, Construction of Miscellaneous Buildings. It is currently anticipated that the Government will conduct a site visit in mid-January 2026. The specific date, time, location, and access requirements will be identified in forthcoming solicitation. Please DO NOT request an updated schedule if estimated dates are surpassed; the Government will release all information publicly through PIEE and SAM when updates are available. Requests for schedule updates may be ignored. A DRAFT copy of the requirement specifications are included as an attachment to this Notice. Changes may be made to this document prior to any subsequent solicitation. Questions related to the draft specifications will NOT be entertained; instructions for submitting questions related to any future solicited specifications will be included in any forthcoming solicitation. Any available technical data will be furnished with any forthcoming solicitation. Following solicitation release, all responsible sources may submit a bid that shall be considered by the agency. This project and/or the anticipated solicitation may be changed, delayed, or canceled at any time. The anticipated solicitation and attachments may be posted in Portable Document Format (.pdf) which will require Adobe Acrobat Reader to open and view files. Adobe Acrobat Reader may be downloaded free of charge at http://www.adobe.com/products/reader. All prospective Offerors should be registered in the PIEE system at least one (1) week prior to the anticipated bid due date. Registration is not required to download any forthcoming solicitation documents, plans, and/or specifications, but IS required to submit a bid. Copies of the solicitation and attachments will be made available for inspection without charge after the solicitation is released, when accessed through PIEE. Failure to register in PIEE will prevent submission of bids as the Government will not accept them by any other means. See linked PIEE registration instructions and web-based training for information about how to access the PIEE Solicitation Module and submit bids. All prospective Offerors must be registered in SAM before the anticipated solicitation closing date. Please see the SAM website for information about SAM registration requirements and approval timelines. It is anticipated that any future solicitation and/or resulting contract will be subject to the E-Verify Employment Eligibility Verification Program (http://www.uscis.gov/e-verify), sustainable acquisition requirements and/or high-performance sustainable building design and construction practices (https://www.epa.gov/greeningepa/guiding-principles-federal-leadership-high?performance-and-sustainable-buildings). Further, one or more of the items under this acquisition is subject to the World Trade Organization Government Procurement Agreement and Free Trade Agreements. USACE will not notify prospective Offerors of any changes to the solicitation; Offerors must monitor PIEE and SAM for the solicitation to be posted, and for any posted changes or amendments. The ONLY Interested Vendors / Plan Holders / Bidders List is available through SAM.gov; Contractors are responsible for identifying their entity as an interested vendor and contacting other interested vendors. title: Switzerland – Insulation work – ETH Zürich, EKZ Wassereintritt, Dilafugen, BKP 225 Spezielle Abdichtungen
description: Im ETH Gebäude EKZ (gesamter Energiekanal im Zentrum) sind die Dilatationsfugen undicht und müssen saniert werden. Dies geschieht Aufgrund der überschrittenen Lebensdauer der Dilatationsfugen und damit die Sicherheit für den laufenden Betrieb weiterhin gewährleistet werden kann. Eine Sanierung aller Dilatationsfugen im EKZ ist vorzunehmen. Angaben des Schadstoff-Fachplaners ist die Dichtungsmasse der Dilatationsfugen nicht schadstoffbelastet und kann daher ohne grosse Schutzvorkehrungen ersetzt werden. Die Dilatationsfugen sind fachgerecht mit geeigneter Dichtungsmasse abzudichten und allenfalls mit einem zusätzlichen, der Funktion entsprechenden Abdichtungsbandes (z.B. Combiflex) zu überkleben. Bereiche mit stärkeren Wassereintritten sind zudem zusätzlich mit Betoninjektionen abzudichten. Durch die erschwerten Zugänglichkeiten hinter den bestehenden Installationen und den hohen Temperaturen im Energiekanal wird die Ausführung der Arbeiten erschwert.

Zadavatel uzavře smlouvu s vybraným dodavatelem. Případné přetoky vyrobené elektrické energie budou dodávány do distribuční sítě. Tato veřejná zakázka je financována z projektu financovaného EU a vyhlášené výzvy ModF–RES+ č. 4/2025, Program 2. Nové obnovitelné zdroje v energetice (RES+). Podmínky dotace jsou dostupné, včetně metodik, na webových stránkách www.modernizacni-fond.cz, případně v příloze č.7_Podmínky dotace. Blíže specifikován je předmět veřejné zakázky v přílohách: PD_VŘ_FVE ČOV Znojmo a PD_VŘ_FVE ÚV Znojmo a v Příloze č.2 – Technická specifikace, této zadávací dokumentace.

description: Ziekenhuis AZ Turnhout treedt voor deze opdracht op als een aankoopcentrale in de zin van artikel 47 §2 en artikel 129 van de wet van 17 juni 2016. Dit betekent dat AZ Turnhout vzw in naam van de verschillende aanbestedende overheden voor deze opdracht in de hoedanigheid van aanbestedende overheid zal optreden. De aankoopcentrale zal de procedure voor overheidsopdrachten toepassen volgens de instructies en in naam en voor rekening van de betrokken aanbestedende overheden. Na afloop van de procedure zal de aankoopcentrale de overheidsopdracht gebeurlijk gunnen indien hierover consensus is bereikt door de aanbestedende overheden. Na afloop van de gunning dienen de aanbestedende overheden zelf een overeenkomst te sluiten met de aanbesteder aan wie de overheidsopdracht werd toegewezen. De aankoopcentrale is belast met de plaatsing en de sluiting van huidige opdracht teneinde te voldoen aan zijn eigen behoeften alsook aan deze van andere aanbestedende overheden hierna genoemd: Volgende entiteiten zijn potentiële afnemers van onderhavige opdracht van leveringen: - Ziekenhuis Geel - Ziekenhuis HH Mol - Ziekenhuis AZ Turnhout - Ziekenhuis AZ Herentals - Ziekenhuis AZ Rivierenland In voorkomend geval worden de bestellingen rechtstreeks door deze afnemers bij de leveranciers geplaatst. Eens één van de afnemers een bestelling heeft geplaatst, dan staat ook deze afnemer zelf in voor leiding en het toezicht op de opdracht (in de zin van artikel 1 van de algemene aannemingsvoorwaarden) en de algemene opvolging van de bestelling en verdere toepassing van het bestek en de algemene en bijzondere aannemingsvoorwaarden. Ook de levering en facturatie verloopt rechtstreeks naar deze afnemers. De nodige gegevens zullen ten gepaste tijde aan de leverancier worden overgemaakt. Het ziekenhuis dat optreedt als aankoopcentrale is op geen enkele wijze aansprakelijk voor de inhoud en afhandeling van de bestellingen van de andere afnemers. De leidend ambtenaar van de aankoopcentrale is de contactpersoon voor elke belangrijke correspondentie betreffende het verloop van de procedure.

Juridiset palvelut voivat sisältää, mutta eivät rajoitu seuraaviin: oikeudelliset selvitykset, auditoinnit, neuvonannot, asiakirjojen laatimiset sekä koulutus. Juridiset palvelut eivät sisällä oikeudenkäyntejä., Osa-alue 4: Tietosuoja ja tekoäly Tämä osa-alue pitää sisällään seuraavat kokonaisuudet: Tietosuoja ja tekoäly. Juridiset palvelut voivat sisältää, mutta eivät rajoitu seuraaviin: oikeudelliset selvitykset, auditoinnit, neuvonannot, asiakirjojen laatimiset sekä koulutus. Juridiset palvelut eivät sisällä oikeudenkäyntejä., Osa-alue 5: Palvelussuhteisiin liittyvä lainsäädäntö Tämä osa-alue pitää sisällään seuraavat kokonaisuudet: Palvelussuhdelainsäädäntö, Työterveys, työturvallisuus, yhteistoiminta ja neuvottelumenettelyt. Juridiset palvelut voivat sisältää, mutta eivät rajoitu seuraaviin: oikeudelliset selvitykset, auditoinnit, neuvonannot, asiakirjojen laatimiset sekä koulutus. Juridiset palvelut eivät sisällä oikeudenkäyntejä., Osa-alue 6: Työvoimapalvelulainsäädäntö ja kotouttamiseen liittyvä lainsäädäntö Tämä osa-alue pitää sisällään seuraavat kokonaisuudet: Työvoimapalvelulainsäädäntö, työttömyysturvalainsäädäntö, kotoutumisen edistämisen lainsäädäntö sekä mainittuihin oikeudenaloihin liittyvä juridisten ohjeiden laatiminen. title: Mittenza für Muttenz - maison de la culture Réaménagement et rénovation I BKP 216 Travaux de pierre naturelle
description:
La commune de Muttenz prévoit la rénovation et la réaffectation partielle d'un bâtiment existant à plusieurs étages, situé au sein du complexe « Mittenza », dans le centre historique. Le complexe comprend plusieurs corps de bâtiment ; le présent projet porte exclusivement sur l'ancien bâtiment hôtelier et de congrès.


Construit vers 1975, ce bâtiment fait partie d'un ensemble d'importance régionale et est classé monument historique au niveau cantonal. Après une période de vacance partielle, l'édifice sera remis en état et affecté à de nouveaux usages. La grande salle sera conservée pour accueillir des événements culturels et sociaux. Par ailleurs, des espaces seront aménagés pour l'administration, l'école de musique, ainsi que pour diverses activités associatives et communautaires.


Le présent appel d'offres concerne les travaux en pierre naturelle (code BKP 216) nécessaires à la rénovation et à la réaffectation de l'ancien bâtiment hôtelier et de congrès.


Le marché porte notamment sur la remise en état, la restauration et le remplacement partiel de revêtements, soubassements, escaliers et appuis de fenêtre en pierre naturelle. Ces prestations incluent le démontage soigneux et la réutilisation des éléments en pierre naturelle existants, la fourniture et la pose d'éléments complémentaires, ainsi que les traitements de surface et les travaux de jointoiement, conformément aux documents d'appel d'offres et au descriptif des prestations. Le marché comprend également les prestations annexes nécessaires à une exécution dans les règles de l'art.


Le bâtiment est situé en milieu urbain dense. Durant la phase de travaux, une attention particulière devra être portée au contexte local, à la logistique du chantier, ainsi qu'aux riverains et aux équipements publics avoisinants.


La description détaillée des prestations figure dans les documents d'appel d'offres.

title: Mittenza für Muttenz - maison de la culture Réaménagement et rénovation I BKP 221.3 Fenêtres en acier
description:
La commune de Muttenz prévoit la rénovation et la reconversion partielle d'un bâtiment existant à plusieurs étages, situé au sein du complexe « Mittenza », dans le centre historique. title: Appel d'offres pour le transport des élèves – École médico-pédagogique de Wetzikon
description:
L'appel d'offres porte sur le transport de personnes (trajets domicile-école, déplacements vers des séances de thérapie ou la piscine, excursions) concernant des élèves de tous niveaux scolaires (âgés de 4 à 20 ans) — parfois accompagnés — dans le cadre de l'enseignement spécialisé, pour le compte de l'école d'éducation spécialisée (Heilpädagogische Schule) de Wetzikon (ZH). Les trajets domicile-école sont effectués sous forme de transports collectifs ; les trajets individuels constituent l'exception. Les prestations doivent être assurées au moyen de véhicules adaptés appartenant au prestataire ; le transport de personnes en fauteuil roulant doit être garanti. L'ensemble des réglementations relatives au transport de personnes — notamment celles en vigueur dans le canton de Zurich — doivent être respectées. Le volume de la prestation est susceptible de varier durant la durée du contrat.


Cet appel d'offres s'adresse à des entreprises de transport spécialisées disposant des capacités requises, des autorisations nécessaires et d'un personnel formé de manière adéquate.

title: Espoon Asunnot Oy / Kipparinkuja 1 peruskorjaus
description: Espoon Asunnot Oy / Kipparinkuja 1 peruskorjaus Hanke käsittää Espoon Kivenlahdessa osoitteessa Kipparinkuja 1 Espoo sijaitsevien asuinkerrostalojen peruskorjauksen. Rakennushankkeessa peruskorjataan laajasti vuonna 1977 rakennettu asuinkerrostalo, kahdeksan porrashuoneen neljä - yhdeksänkerroksinen asuinkerrostalo kellarikerroksella. Myös tontin piha-alueet kunnostetaan. Työt käsittävät kaikki tavanomaiseen peruskorjaukseen kohdentuvat rakennustyöt. Rakennustyö sisältää maanrakennus-, piha-, parveke/julkisivu-, hissi-, ja sisärakennus- sekä talotekniikkatöitä. Julkisivujen ulkokuoret puhdistetaan, salaojia + lämpöputkia uusitaan, parvekkeet korjataan, vesiputkia uusitaan, ikkunat ja parvekeovet uusitaan, hissit uusitaan, pihoja uusitaan sekä huoneistot ja talotekniikkaa uusitaan. Kohteeseen rakennetaan myös maalämpöjärjestelmä. Kohde tullaan toteuttamaan vaiheittain kolmessa vaiheessa. Urakoitsijan on saatava edellinen vaihe valmiiksi ennen seuraavan aloitusta. Vaiheistus on esitetty tarjouspyynnön liitteessä (vaiheistussuunnitelma). Huoneistot ja liiketilat tyhjennetään vaiheittain peruskorjausta varten. Portaat F-G-H tyhjennetään vuokralaisista 31.10.2026 mennessä. Muiden talojen tyhjennysaikataulun ilmoittaa urakoitsija tarjouksessaan. vuokralaiset täytyy irtisanoa vähintään 7kk ennen talojen tyhjennystä. Jokaisen vaiheen valmistuttua muuttavat vuokralaiset takaisin valmistuneisiin asuntoihin. Vaiheistus: Vaihe 1: Porrashuoneet H,G ja F Vaihe 2: Porrashuoneet E,D ja C Vaihe 3: Porrashuoneet A ja B Urakoitsija päättää missä vaiheessa piha-alueen työt tehdään. Rakennushankkeen suunnittelijat, suunnittelun jakautuminen, sijainti ja tarkemmat paljoustiedot on esitetty urakkaohjelmassa. Rakennuttaja pyrkii siihen, että urakkasopimukset voidaan tehdä mahdollisimman pian urakkakilpailun päättymisestä ja rakennustyöt alkaisivat joulukuussa 2026 edellyttäen kuitenkin, että Espoon Asunnot Oy:n hallitus on hyväksynyt hankkeen, tehdystä hankintapäätöksestä ei valiteta ja rakentamislupa on myönnetty. Kiinteistöön pääsee tutustumaan paikan päällä 17.11.2026 klo 12:00 sekä 18.11.2026 Klo 10:00.,

title: France – Tents – Acquisition de systèmes de décontamination au profit de petits détachements et prestations associées
description: L’objet du marché est l’acquisition de systèmes de décontamination de petits détachements (SDPD). L’objet du marché est l’acquisition de systèmes de décontamination de petits détachements (SDPD). Un système est constitué d’un ensemble d’éléments mobiles, modulables et cohérentes, permettant la décontamination approfondie d’un petit détachement de 6 à 12 personnels et de son matériel en toute autonomie. Le système de décontamination est décomposé en d’une part, un « cœur système » et d’autre part, des matériels et consommables pour son exploitation. Le « cœur système », pour être fonctionnel, est constitué a minima d’une tente metallotextile avec bulle de protection NRBC, d’une source mobile d’énergie conditionnée en caisse de transport, de douches mobiles, de tuyauteries et de réservoirs souples pour la fourniture d’eau propre et la récupération des effluents, et d’un mât d’éclairage extérieur et d’éclairages intérieurs et des équipements réparables. L’autre partie du système est constitué de l’ensemble des petits équipements et consommables nécessaires pour établir un chantier de décontamination : mobiliers mobiles, petits matériels de décontamination et consommables associés. title: Germany – Research and development services and related consultancy services – [AI-as-OS] Artificial Intelligence as Operating System
description: Artificial intelligence (AI) methods have been expanding into new areas of application for years. AI systems are increasingly capable of handling complex tasks with greater autonomy—for example, through agent-based approaches that run an AI agent on a computer to perform any task automatically or even autonomously, sometimes without explicit human instructions but rather based on identified intentions (see, for example, the open-source software OpenClaw, which can handle tasks such as calendar maintenance or file management). Just how deeply AI algorithms and models are now integrated into everyday applications is also evident in the fact that end devices are increasingly operable entirely without visible applications and exclusively via voice control, which fundamentally rethinks the way we interact with them (such as Deutsche Telekom’s AI Phone). The central control units of such end devices—the operating systems themselves—are also increasingly being enhanced with new AI functionalities to continuously improve system efficiency. These include initial theoretical—and in some cases already practical—approaches to using the latest AI technologies for file system or storage management. These developments mark a fundamental paradigm shift: AI is no longer viewed merely as an add-on, but increasingly as a native architectural component of the operating system itself. The AI-as-OS program aims to explore how artificial intelligence can be understood not merely as a separately encapsulated functionality that is simply executed by the operating system, but as the operating system itself—Artificial Intelligence as Operating System. Behind this lies the vision of an AI that not only supports individual applications but also acts as the central control system for the entire computer ecosystem, managing system resources (including the CPU, RAM, and system security) in a data-driven, adaptive, and context-aware manner. The aim of the program is to make fundamental contributions to the development of AI-based operating systems as the control unit of a computer system. Through the extensive integration of AI technologies into deep operating system layers, such a system is intended to manage system resources, enable context-aware operational decisions, and enhance system security through adaptive threat detection and defense. Since the underlying technology is still largely in a speculative stage, the scope of development work ranges from the general architecture of such an operating system to the integration of AI-based core mechanisms, and includes new considerations regarding the security and stability requirements for such an operating system, depending on the target platform (e.g., desktop, data center, edge device) and the application environment. The program’s main areas of research include: • AI-Centric Operating System Architectures: Concepts for the fundamental design of an operating system in which AI is viewed not as an add-on feature but as an integral part of the architecture. • AI-Native Core Mechanisms: Integration of AI-based methods into core operating system functions such as resource management, process control, and memory organization. • Control, Security, and Stability: Requirements for traceability, controllability, and robustness of an AI-based operating system, as well as approaches to adaptive threat detection and defense. From today’s perspective, it remains to be seen whether—and to what extent—the vision of an AI-native operating system can be technically realized. This is precisely where the program’s value lies: AI-as-OS explores a largely speculative field at the intersection of AI research and system software, the results of which could set the course for the operating systems of tomorrow.

title: France – Hotel, restaurant and retail trade services – Prestations de restauration collective d’entreprise pour EDF SA, et ses filiales
description: Le marché a pour objet la réalisation de prestations de restauration collective d’entreprise pour EDF SA et ses filiales. Il est structuré en trois lots : un lot Nord incluant l’Île-de-France, un lot Sud, et un lot Campus dédié aux prestations de “parahôtellerie”. Chaque lot sera attribué à un attributaire unique ; un même opérateur ne pourra pas être retenu simultanément pour les lots 1 et 2, mais pourra obtenir deux lots dans les seules combinaisons suivantes : lot 1 + lot 3 ou lot 2 + lot 3. Le marché prendra la forme d’un accord-cadre d’une durée ferme de quatre ans, pouvant être prolongé par quatre options de douze mois chacune, et sera exécuté pour les besoins d’EDF SA ainsi que des filiales mentionnées dans le règlement de consultation. AVIS pour les 3 lots numéro AVIS020323 sur https://pha2.edf.com

buyer: Direktion für Sicherheit, Umwelt und Energie
title: Tierpark Bern Dählhölzli, Neu- und Ersatzbauten, 291 Architekturleistungen, Studienauftrag mit 2 Lose
description:
La Ville de Berne gère plusieurs installations zoologiques sous le nom de « Tierpark Bern » (Parc zoologique de Berne). Elle offre à la population des possibilités de détente et des expériences personnelles, transmet et développe des connaissances sur la faune et la flore, et sensibilise le public à la détention des animaux dans le respect de leurs besoins, ainsi qu’à la protection de la nature et des espèces. Le Tierpark Bern comprend notamment les sites du Dählhölzli et du Parc aux ours (Bären Park). Afin de répondre aux besoins d’un nombre croissant de visiteurs et d’assurer une détention des animaux adaptée à leurs besoins, des investissements sont prévus dans les infrastructures et les enclos existants ainsi que dans de nouvelles installations. Par ailleurs, des mesures sont envisagées pour améliorer les conditions de travail du personnel. Parallèlement, le Tierpark Bern entend accorder une attention accrue, à l’avenir, aux défis posés par le changement climatique et la perte de biodiversité. Le périmètre du projet abrite en outre des habitats et des espèces protégés par la Loi fédérale sur la protection de la nature et du paysage (LPN) ; leur préservation, ou une compensation équivalente, doit impérativement être prise en compte lors du développement du projet.


La réalisation de ces objectifs implique des transformations spatiales. Il s’agit de créer de nouvelles installations et de remplacer celles qui sont vétustes. De plus, l’accès au site du Dählhölzli doit être amélioré pour les personnes en situation de handicap. Cette démarche constitue un élément essentiel de la planification globale du Tierpark Bern pour la période 2023–2033, laquelle décrit en détail la vision et la stratégie de ce qui se veut être « le parc zoologique le plus charmant de Suisse ».

description: Capability Program Executive Command and Control Information Network (CPE C2IN) Commercial Solution Opening (CSO) Call for Solutions (CfS) for Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) Commercial Digital Intermediate Frequency Subsystem (DIFS) under the Army Open Solicitation (AOS) Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) Project Office/Customer Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) Contracting Activity Army Contracting Command � Aberdeen Proving Ground (ACC-APG) CSO Number Army Open Solicitation (AOS) - W9128Z-25-S-A002 Call for Solution Title Commercial Digital Intermediate Frequency Subsystem (DIFS) under the Army Open Solicitation (AOS) Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) Contracting Points of Contact Contracting Officer: Licinda Peters Email: licinda.m.peters.civ@army.mil Contract Specialist: Keith Magaw Email: keith.a.magaw.civ@army.mil Questions Due Date/Time 05 November 2026 at noon Eastern Standard Time (EST) Solution Brief Due Date/Time 10 December 2026 at noon Eastern Standard Time (EST) Submit Solution Brief Via Sam.gov and AOS Controlled by U.S. Army Controlled by: PdM WESS CUI Category: Operations Security (OPSEC) Limited Dissemination Control: FEDCON POC: licinda.m.peters.civ@army.mil SECTION 1 - INTRODUCTION BACKGROUND Product Manager Wideband Enterprise Satellite Systems (PdM WESS) is seeking solutions for a Commercial-Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Digital Intermediate Frequency (IF) system to satisfy the requirements for Increment 1 of this modernization effort. The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 � REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solutions for Next-Generation SATCOM Teleports Background & Operational Context Current Department of War (DoW) satellite communications (SATCOM) ground infrastructure relies heavily on legacy L-Band Intermediate Frequency (IF) distribution systems. These analog-hardware-bound architectures limit flexibility, inhibit rapid tech insertion, and create single points of failure across global teleport infrastructures. To counter emerging near-peer threats in dynamic operational environments, the warfighter requires highly resilient, agile, and rapidly scalable SATCOM. The Problem The legacy L-Band architecture fails to offer the ability to dynamically route or transport Radio Frequency (RF) signals over DoW Internet Protocol (IP) networks. This lack of flexibility inhibits the resilience of geostationary earth orbit (GEO) SATCOM operations. To transition to a modern, flexible, software-defined ground segment, the DoW requires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments. SCOPE AND TECHNICAL OBJECTIVES The scope of this effort is to acquire, integrate, test, and field a commercially available or commercial-derivative Digital IF suite, and to operationalize it within existing DoW Teleports. The subsystem shall demonstrate the core capability to digitize analog L-band satellite signals, transport them over a high-speed digital network, and convert them back to analog signals, while handling native digital IF traffic from modems. The subsystem shall leverage mature commercial solutions with an emphasis on automation, reliability, and adherence to open standards, for example, the IEEE-ISTO Std 4900-2021 (DIFI) standard. The offeror shall propose a commercial solution that achieves the following high-level technical objectives, aligned with the core characteristics of the DoW modernization framework: Objective 1: Interoperable Digital IF Conversion (Modular & Open): The DIFS shall convert legacy analog L-band aggregate signals (950 MHz - 2.050 GHz) into standards-compliant Digital IF packet streams and vice versa. This includes both transmit (analog-to-digital) and receive (digital-to-analog) paths, conforming to the DIFI standard to prevent vendor lock-in. Objective 2: Advanced Digital Signal Processing (Adaptable): The commercial subsystem shall combine multiple, disparate Digital IF streams into a single aggregate (combined) stream for uplink and channelize a single aggregate (combined) downlink stream into multiple, individual Digital IF streams for processing. Objective 3: High-Performance Digital Transport (Scalable): The subsystem shall utilize a non-blocking, high-speed digital switch fabric to route Digital IF streams between all subsystem components and external interfaces (e.g., Digital Modems, Global Agile Integrated Transport (GAIT) connections, Wide Area Network (WAN) transport etc. The fabric shall support standard network scaling, redundancy, and high-throughput operations (up to 100 Gigabit Ethernet). The switch fabric shall provide a means for rapid reconfiguration of packet forwarding by the Automated Management and Control Function without the use of Layer 3 routing protocols. The switch fabric shall use deterministic multicast routing based on the incoming port without requiring strict multicast tables. Objective 4: Automated Management and Control (Empowered): The subsystem shall feature a software-based management suite. This software shall automate the establishment, termination, and monitoring of communication paths based on satellite access parameters, manage automatic protection switching for redundant components, and support automated rerouting of critical traffic to alternate facilities. Objective 5: Integrated Test and Diagnostics: The DIFS shall incorporate built-in test capabilities to generate, capture, and analyze Digital IF streams to allow for rapid troubleshooting, performance verification (e.g., Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) & spectral purity), and subsystem health monitoring with minimal operational burden and with on-site test equipment. Objective 6: Resilient and Maintainable Design (Resilient): The commercial solution shall be designed for high availability Ai ? 0.9998) a long service life (15 years), and rapid maintainability (MTTR ? 30 minutes), using standard line-replaceable items (LRIs). Objective 7: Secure and Compliant Architecture (Secure): The subsystem design shall be capable of achieving a Risk Management Framework (RMF) authorization for a security categorization of (Confidentiality, Moderate), (Integrity, Moderate), (Availability, Moderate). description: The Sources Sought results will assist the Air Force in determining whether this solicitation will be unrestricted competition or a small business set-aside for C-Type contract to fulfill Simulator Common Architecture Requirements and Standards (SCARS) requirements. The Government is assessing the capability of companies that may possess the expertise to competently and competitively respond to the following requirements for the SCARS program: For the SCARS Program, the contractor shall possess the capabilities to fulfill 1) Security Operations Center (SOC) Operations, 2) Remote Assessment & Authorization, 3) Software Patching Baseline Integrity, 4) Maintain a SCARS Library, 5) Edge Virtualization & Modern Deployment on SCARS On-Premise Equipment (OPE), 6) Network Integration & Management, 7) Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), 8) Governance of Architecture Standards, 9) Enterprise Logistics & Fielding, 10) Data Requirements and 11) Security Requirements. The contract will commence CY2030 with an anticipated transition period up to six (6) months leading to full operational performance in CY 2031. title: Request for Information (RFI) for the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP)
description: FEMA is modernizing the National Flood Insurance Program to improve how it assesses and communicates flood risk, prices and delivers flood insurance, manages floodplains, and provides mitigation assistance. The goal is to help individuals, communities, states, and private-sector partners better understand and reduce flood risk while using policyholder and taxpayer funds efficiently. To support this effort, FEMA is integrating staff, initiatives, and support structures into a more unified NFIP operating model. The draft contract support model described in the RFI pursues those outcomes. Work will be grouped into several categories described in the RFI. Not all current NFIP support contracts will be recompeted immediately. title: Industry Day - USACE SPK Geotechnical Drilling and Laboratory Services
description: Special Notice: Virtual Industry Day Event Schedule & Platform Date of Event: December 10, 2026 (Thursday) Time: 1:00 PM � 2:00 PM Pacific Standard Time (PST) Location/Platform: Virtual via Microsoft Teams (see below for details) Purpose of Event The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Sacramento District (USACE-SPK) is pleased to announce a virtual Industry Day on December 10, 2026. The purpose of this session is to provide industry partners with a comprehensive overview of the upcoming Geotechnical Drilling Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC). The Government will present details regarding program requirements, anticipated geographic scope, proposed technical evaluation factors (such as specialized rig fleet inventory and AASHTO/USACE MTC laboratory accreditation standards), and the tentative acquisition milestone schedule. USACE-SPK anticipates issuing a formal solicitation under NAICS 541360in February 2027., and highly encourage participation from regional small businesses, prospective joint venture partners, and specialty subcontractors who intend to compete. Scope of Work and Technical Capabilities USACE-SPK seeks firms with the capabilities to provide comprehensive geotechnical drilling, cone penetrometer testing (CPT) services, and test-pit excavations utilizing backhoes and track hoes. The principal features of the work encompass soil drilling and sampling utilizing hollow-stem flight augers, solid-stem flight augers, mud-rotary, air-rotary, and percussion drilling methods, including ODEX, Down-hole Casing Advance Systems, or other specialized percussion drilling systems. Contract requirements will also mandate sonic drilling and sampling, alongside rock core drilling and sampling of up to 6-inch diameter using wireline or conventional diamond-impregnated drill bits. Soil sampling operations will require standard penetrometers and other split-barrel samplers up to 3-inch-diameter, as well as undisturbed soil sampling using Shelby push tubes and Pitcher barrels with Pitcher tubes. Field operations will further include CPT testing, piezometer and inclinometer installations, hydraulic pressure testing associated with rock core drilling, and observation well installation and development, which includes pump, permeability, and percolation testing. Contractors will be responsible for generating all associated documentation, to include detailed drill logs, trench or test-pit logs, as-built diagrams for all instrumentation and well installations, and percolation test records. Additionally, the contractor must occasionally furnish the professional services of a registered, licensed Geologist or Geotechnical Engineer. Furthermore, firms must possess the capability to provide certified geotechnical laboratory services. The required testing scope includes moisture content, soil classification, sieve analysis, hydrometer, Atterberg limits, consolidation, triaxial testing, direct shear, California Bearing Ratio (CBR), organic content, and Specific Gravity. To ensure data integrity, all laboratory testing must be performed by a facility accredited by the American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials (AASHTO) in accordance with the corresponding ASTM standards. Finally, the laboratory must be, or successfully become, validated by the USACE Materials Testing Center (MTC) for all requested testing methods.
